## Objective

Reduce ordinary verification cost by deleting duplicate and advisory ownership while preserving every distinct escaped-failure check.

## Owned scope

Remove advisory test/production ratio and command-document probes from ordinary broad runs. Delete universal fresh-eye and fingerprint cadence, redundant test families, duplicate wrappers, fixtures, catalogs, and prose together. Keep one focused implementation path plus one integrated core lane; retain release-only mutation, reviewer delivery, closeout verdict, packaging/install checks, and shared-tree fingerprinting only as fallback for an untyped reviewer.

## Acceptance

- Ordinary implementation uses focused tests and the integrated core lane.
- Advisory ratio and command-doc checks run only at release or explicit selection.
- Changed-line mutation runs only in an explicitly authorized release lane.
- Every retained expensive check names its unique escaped failure.
- Each removed gate loses its obsolete owners together with its tests and documentation.
- Each deletion cluster has consumer-search evidence and focused positive/negative controls.

##
readback.title: Collapse ordinary verification cost and duplicate tests
